A '''species''' of horned, primitive [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]-dwelling [[Primate/Legends|primates]] had evolved from a [[Devaronian precursor species precursor species|species]] of horned [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] used their horns as a defensive weapon against [[Bird/Legends|birds]] of prey. The species eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] species.<ref name="GG4" />
